items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: See, when I was playing music with Ernest Johnson, Doug Ernest, he lived down in Irish Channel, around St. Thomas Street. And he used to get white... He knew these people out there, see.

ctx.x: Did you play in Irish Channel?

Yeah, I played Irish Channel every time. See, when I was playing music with Ernest Johnson, Doug Ernest, he lived down in Irish Channel, around St. Thomas Street. And he used to get white... He knew these people out there, see. And he used to get white from these people, whatever dances they had. They were pretty quiet bunch of people?
Yeah, they were nice people. I didn't find nothing wrong with them. No?
